blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Expectations of higher US interest rates bolstered the greenback and dragged the Philippine peso past 63 per dollar for the first time on Thursday, putting the spotlight on how the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) will respond to stubbornly high inflation and currency volatility.
